scenario.name: Local benign base64 decode with certutil
scenario.description: The signed certutil utility decoded a PEM-style base64 fixture into inert text and the output hash matched the expected bytes.

sensors.name: Sysmon
sensors.config_notes: Verification-grade unfiltered process, network, DNS, file, and registry coverage; LSASS ProcessAccess EID 10 enabled.

network_capture.reason: The scenario decoded a local fixture and produced no Sysmon EID 3 or EID 22 events.

tool.name: certutil.exe
tool.source: Built into the target operating system

input_file.content: PEM-style base64 of an inert UTF-8 marker string

commands.completion_assessment: The reporting wrapper did not retain the numeric exit property, so success is recorded from certutil's explicit completion output and the matching output hash rather than inventing an exit code.

observed_techniques.name: Deobfuscate/Decode Files or Information
observed_techniques.observation: Certutil decoded the local base64 fixture and wrote bytes whose SHA-256 matched the expected benign plaintext.

network.assessment: No network activity was part of the local flow and none was observed; no packet capture was required.

files.assessment: Sysmon attributed creation of the 42-byte decoded output directly to certutil.exe.

registry.assessment: Certutil initialized three cryptography OID entries. They are legitimate API state and not specific enough for a standalone decode rule.

process_identity.assessment: Sysmon captured certutil identity, the -decode switch, input and output paths, hashes, SYSTEM user, and System integrity.

parent_child.assessment: The controlled PowerShell wrapper launched certutil. Certutil created only conhost.exe; decoded content was not executed.

evidence.description: Sanitized process lifetime, ancestry, file, registry, and explicit no-network findings.

validation.pysigma: Both Sigma rules parsed successfully with pySigma 1.5.0 on 2026-08-10.
validation.json: verification.json and the sanitized evidence JSON file passed JSON validation on 2026-08-10.

sanitization.notes: Only selected telemetry fields, hashes, timestamps, aggregate counts, lab topology values, and benign fixture content are committed.
